build_jfrog_detector: build a detect-secrets plugin that scans for JFrog API keys and identity tokens using regex patterns
create_jfrog_denylist: create regex patterns to detect 73-character JFrog API keys and 64-character identity tokens in code
test_jfrog_secret_detection: test the JFrogDetector class to verify it finds JFrog secrets in sample files
review_jfrog_regex_patterns: review the JFrogDetector denylist regex patterns for JFrog Artifactory Bintray and Xray secret coverage
refactor_jfrog_secret_type: refactor the JFrogDetector secret_type property to return a custom token label
